subject.en: Walnut and brass prairie arcade joystick
subject.zh: 胡桃木与黄铜的西部街机摇杆

description.en: A short ball-top joystick leans from a compact walnut arcade box. Its two close buttons and thick housing form one complete, comfortably inset assembly.
description.zh: 短球头摇杆从紧凑的胡桃木街机盒伸出，两颗按钮与厚实机箱组成完整、留足余量的主体。

description.en: Real wood grain and engraved aged brass give the prairie shooter a handmade arcade identity. The deep-red joystick leads, supported by one close ochre-and-teal button group.
description.zh: 木纹与刻线旧黄铜为西部射击游戏建立手作街机形象。深红摇杆是视觉中心，赭黄与青色按钮紧邻成组。

description.en: A low rising sun with short prairie grass cuts and concentric joystick-like arcs in warm sand paper. The field, grain and contact shadow are independent of transparent app marks.
description.zh: 沙色纸面上的低日弧线、草叶切线与摇杆圆弧呼应西部草原。 底色、颗粒与接触阴影均独立于透明应用标记。

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the red joystick, two buttons and wood block remain clear. At 32/24/16 px, the compact silhouette and dominant colors carry recognition; fine material detail, printed marks and background lines naturally merge.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能辨认红色摇杆、双按钮与木盒；32/24/16 px 以紧凑轮廓和主色维持识别，精细材质、印记与背景线条自然合并。

goal.en: Play a pixel prairie shooter with keyboard or touch controls, survive enemy waves with power-ups, and save scores to an all-time leaderboard.
goal.zh: 用键盘或触控方向键游玩像素草原射击，收集道具、抵挡敌人波次，并将成绩保存到历史排行榜。

role.en: Game HUD, touch controls, and leaderboard
role.zh: 游戏状态、触控操作与排行榜

role.en: Static assets, health, and score APIs
role.zh: 静态资源、健康检查与成绩 API

role.en: Persistent rankings and duplicate submission protection
role.zh: 排名持久化与重复提交保护

description.en: A low rising sun, short grass cuts and joystick-like arcs bring the prairie into the arcade frame.
description.zh: 低低升起的太阳、短草线与摇杆弧轨，把西部草原带进街机画框。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥119px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 119px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
